name: Nature Sounds
description: High-quality white noise generator with beautiful nature sounds. Ocean surf, rain, wind, rivers, and storms for relaxation and focus.
longDescription: Nature Sounds is a premium white noise generator featuring 5 realistic nature environments with advanced audio synthesis. Each environment combines multiple layered audio sources using pink, brown, and white noise types for authentic soundscapes. Features individual layer controls, preset environment blends, timer functionality, and audio-reactive visualizations. Perfect for relaxation, focus, meditation, or sleep aid.
author: Wavelength Consulting
